answer: A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The jetty counter is kept in pulse and hollow publishes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4742 identities would post 2078 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
